gates.label: Release integrity (artifacts, updater, rollback, uninstall, control agreement)
gates.note: bootstrap.mjs takes `install | --health [--offline] [--root <dir>]` — there is no `--release` flag (plan-QC defect 2; the app-install leg is fail-closed refused until a release-authorized candidate exists). checksums/verify.mjs requires --file plus --sha256, or --id + --version (+ --platform) — a bare positional argument exits 2 (plan-QC defect 3). macOS signature check: `bash apps/candice-companion/scripts/package-macos/verify-gatekeeper.sh <app-bundle-path>` — the script assesses a .app bundle via spctl, not a DMG path. Windows: `powershell -File apps/candice-companion/scripts/package-windows/verify-signature.ps1 -Path <nsis-exe>`. Updater atomicity, rollback, downgrade refusal, uninstall cleanup, notices and licenses are recorded with commands, exit codes, and unedited output.

gates.label: Independent QC review
gates.note: A fresh independent reviewer (never a builder/fixer on any FIX-001..023 lane) repeats the release-critical subset from downloaded artifacts on clean machines, verifies the completion report against every cited evidence file, then signs the verdict block. The signer field is left blank by the generator; only the independent human reviewer may fill it. Any fail, required skip, missing or stale evidence, open P0/P1 defect, or control-file disagreement is an automatic FAIL. Builder state caps at BUILT_AWAITING_QC; release_ready becomes true only after the independent verdict.
